title: Attenborough: the amazing Lyre Bird sings like a chainsaw! Now in high quality | BBC Earth
summary: A short BBC Earth clip from David Attenborough's Life of Birds showing a lyrebird imitating sounds, including a chainsaw and camera shutter, so accurately it is hard to tell from the real thing.
why: Shared whenever birds mimic sounds come up, as a mind-blowing example of vocal mimicry.

quote.text: Here's the one that blows my mind
